newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up, but off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up, but off early highs.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Tuesday, but were off early highs above 1,400 points as profit-taking in select blue chips trimmed the gains, dealers said.

"One reason for the improved sentiment is that the fears about postponement of elections have eased," dealer Mudassar Malik said. "The market was oversold and all the volume leaders gained, but profit-taking pulled the index down."
The Karachi 100-share index rose 15.30 points, or 1.11 percent, to end at 1,396.32 amid 149 gainers and 40 losers. PTCL rose 0.50 rupees to 25.70. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
Bank of Punjab rose 1.0 rupee to 18.25 and Muslim Commercial Bank 1.55 to 32.25. Adamjee Insurance rose 1.25 to 89.50. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 1.10 to 32.65.
Hub Power Co rose 0.20 to 34.45 and Pakistan State Oil 2.0 to 275. PTCL rose 0.70 to 25.70 and Telecard Ltd 4.0 to 52. Fauji Fertilizer rose 1.0 to 70.
